5f13ce87-37b1-5155-a727-3e8a95d2f53e.document_title: A New Generation of SMS Communication JorMall
5f13ce87-37b1-5155-a727-3e8a95d2f53e.content:
A New Generation of SMS Communication
JorMall has completed a new chatbot solution that can be connected to SMS campaigns, transforming a traditional text message into an interactive customer experience.
Instead of receiving a message that only provides information, customers can tap the link in the SMS and immediately interact with a chatbot designed specifically for your business. The chatbot can answer questions, present products and services, guide customers through available options, request calls from the sales team, and help them take the next step.
How the Service Works
Step | Stage | What Happens
1 | Campaign preparation | Your business chooses the purpose of the campaign, the target audience, and the action you want customers to take.
2 | Customized chatbot | JorMall prepares a chatbot using approved information about your company, products, services, offers, and frequently asked questions.
3 | SMS delivery | The SMS is sent to the selected audience and includes a clear call to action with a link to the chatbot.
4 | Customer interaction | Customers open the link, ask questions, explore information, and receive immediate guidance through a simple conversational interface.
5 | Follow-up | Sales callback requests can support your sales, service, and follow-up process, according to the agreed campaign setup.
What the Chatbot Can Do
Answer frequently asked questions at any time.
Explain products, services, features, prices, locations, or campaign details using your approved information.
Guide customers toward the most relevant product, service, branch, or next action.
Request a call from the sales team.
Support promotions, launches, events, surveys, appointments, and after-sales communication.
Communicate in Arabic, English, or both, based on the agreed setup.

جورمول
حوّل كل رسالة قصيرة إلى حوار تفاعلي
نقدّم لكم خدمة جورمول للرسائل القصيرة التفاعلية المدعومة بالشات بوت
طريقة أكثر ذكاءً للترويج والتعريف والدعم وخدمة عملائكم—مباشرةً من خلال رسالة قصيرة.
وثيقة تعريفية للعملاء
خدمة جورمول للرسائل القصيرة التفاعلية •
جورمول | حلول الرسائل القصيرة التفاعلية
جيل جديد من التواصل عبر الرسائل القصيرة
أنجزت جورمول حلاً جديداً للشات بوت يمكن ربطه بحملات الرسائل القصيرة، بما يحوّل الرسالة النصية التقليدية إلى تجربة تفاعلية للعملاء.
بدلاً من استلام رسالة تقتصر على تقديم المعلومات، يستطيع العميل الضغط على الرابط الموجود في الرسالة والتفاعل فوراً مع شات بوت مصمم خصيصاً لنشاطكم. ويمكن للشات بوت الإجابة عن الأسئلة، وعرض المنتجات والخدمات، وإرشاد العملاء إلى الخيارات المتاحة، وجمع الاستفسارات، ومساعدتهم على اتخاذ الخطوة التالية.
كيف تعمل الخدمة؟
الخطوة | المرحلة | ما الذي يحدث؟
1 | إعداد الحملة | تحدد مؤسستكم هدف الحملة والجمهور المستهدف والإجراء المطلوب من العملاء.
2 | شات بوت مخصص | تُعدّ جورمول شات بوت باستخدام المعلومات المعتمدة عن شركتكم ومنتجاتكم وخدماتكم وعروضكم والأسئلة المتكررة.
3 | إرسال الرسالة القصيرة | تُرسل الرسالة إلى الجمهور المحدد، وتتضمن دعوة واضحة لاتخاذ إجراء ورابطاً للدخول إلى الشات بوت.
4 | تفاعل العميل | يفتح العملاء الرابط ويطرحون أسئلتهم ويستعرضون المعلومات ويحصلون على إرشاد فوري من خلال واجهة محادثة سهلة.

ما الذي يستطيع الشات بوت القيام به؟
الإجابة عن الأسئلة المتكررة في أي وقت.
شرح المنتجات والخدمات والمزايا والأسعار والمواقع أو تفاصيل الحملة باستخدام معلوماتكم المعتمدة.
إرشاد العملاء إلى المنتج أو الخدمة أو الفرع الأنسب، أو إلى الإجراء التالي.
جمع استفسارات العملاء وبيانات المهتمين.
دعم العروض الترويجية وإطلاق المنتجات والفعاليات والاستبيانات والمواعيد والتواصل بعد البيع.
التواصل باللغة العربية أو الإنجليزية أو كلتيهما، بحسب الإعداد المتفق عليه.
الفوائد التي تحققها أعمالكم
تفاعل أكبر | منح العملاء وسيلة واضحة ومريحة للتفاعل مع رسائلكم القصيرة.
إجابات أسرع | توفير وصول فوري إلى المعلومات المعتمدة دون الحاجة إلى بدء كل استفسار بمكالمة هاتفية.
تجربة أفضل للعملاء | إرشاد العملاء من خلال محادثة منظمة وسهلة الاستخدام.
حملات أكثر فاعلية | تعزيز قيمة كل رسالة قصيرة لتتجاوز كونها مجرد رسالة ترويجية.
استفسارات أكثر جدية | مساعدة العملاء على فهم خياراتهم قبل التواصل مع فريقكم.
تواصل متسق | تقديم المعلومات من خلال محتوى تراجعه مؤسستكم وتعتمده.
استخدامات عملية
التجزئة والعروض الترويجية: شرح العروض، واقتراح المنتجات، وتوجيه العملاء إلى الفروع أو قنوات الطلب.
خدمة العملاء: الإجابة عن الأسئلة الشائعة وتوجيه العملاء إلى خيار الدعم المناسب.
المواعيد والحجوزات: توضيح المواعيد المتاحة وجمع المعلومات اللازمة للمتابعة.
التعليم والتدريب: عرض البرامج ومعلومات القبول والمواعيد وإرشادات التسجيل.
العقارات والسيارات: عرض العقارات أو المركبات، والإجابة عن الأسئلة الأولية، وجمع بيانات المهتمين.
الفعاليات والإطلاقات: مشاركة التفاصيل، والإجابة عن أسئلة المشاركين، ودعم التسجيل أو الاستفسارات.
الاستبيانات والملاحظات: دعوة العملاء إلى تقديم ملاحظات منظمة بعد الشراء أو الحصول على الخدمة.
مصمم بما يتناسب مع أعمالكم

3f34b12f-95fe-5f6e-90a4-24390679e161.content:
JorMall Common Questions & Standard Responses
Conversational Knowledge File
Purpose: This document contains standard conversational questions that should be recognized before the chatbot knowledge-base search. It intentionally avoids duplicating chatbot-specific facts such as prices, offers, products, locations, dates, specifications, payment, delivery, and other information already supplied during chatbot generation.
For recognition, each item is written as a natural relationship: when the user asks one of the listed questions or a close variation, the chatbot should return the corresponding standard answer. Dynamic placeholders such as {{company_name}}, {{chatbot_name}}, {{chatbot_ending_date}}, {{opt_out_instructions}}, and {{contact_information}} must be filled from the approved chatbot configuration and must never be guessed.

39. Is the Conversation Saved?
إذا قال المستخدم أو كتب عبارات مثل: الشاتبوت محفوظ؟، المحادثة بتتخزن؟
الإجابة المعتمدة: قد يتم حفظ المحادثة وفق إعدادات وسياسة هذه الخدمة لأغراض المتابعة وتحسين الخدمة. عند الحاجة، يجب عرض السياسة المعتمدة الخاصة بالشاتبوت.
If the user asks or writes something like: “Is this chat saved?”, “Is the conversation stored?”, the chatbot should answer: “The conversation may be stored according to this service's configuration and policy for follow-up and service purposes. The approved chatbot policy should be shown when applicable.”

إذا قال المستخدم أو كتب عبارات مثل: كيف أستخدم الشات؟، كيف أبدأ؟، شو أعمل؟

إذا قال المستخدم أو كتب عبارات مثل: رابط الشاتبوت آمن؟، ممكن أثق بالرابط؟
الإجابة المعتمدة: أنت حالياً داخل الرابط المخصص لهذا الشاتبوت. للتأكد دائماً، تحقق من عنوان الموقع قبل إدخال أي بيانات واستخدم الرابط المعتمد الذي تم تزويدك به.
If the user asks or writes something like: “Is the chatbot link safe?”, “Can I trust this link?”

إذا قال المستخدم أو كتب عبارات مثل: مين أرسل لي هذا الشاتبوت؟، مين الجهة اللي أرسلت الشاتبوت؟، مين المرسل؟

fc366c87-266c-54bb-9f65-fc32ee6fad27.content:
A New Generation of SMS Communication
“A New Generation of SMS Communication” is JorMall’s introductory campaign for its Interactive SMS and chatbot service. It demonstrates how a traditional SMS can be transformed into an interactive customer experience by including a link to a customized chatbot.



Customers can open the link to ask questions, explore approved information about the business, learn about its products and services, request a call from the sales team, and receive guidance on the next steps.



In simple terms, instead of sending a one-way text message, businesses can use SMS to direct customers to a customized chatbot experience designed specifically for their needs.

348e41b8-c38c-5369-ace4-b8bc2787f0a8.content:

d2e99319-c65c-5208-a5c1-8b8c72961f31.content:
Product Name: Premium Messages
Description:
Premium Messages is a high-value SMS marketing service designed for clients seeking a fully guided and optimized communication experience. In addition to message delivery, JorMall provides strategic support throughout the campaign cycle — from planning and content creation to targeting and execution — ensuring maximum impact and return on investment.
Key Features:
Campaign Brief Creation:
JorMall’s marketing team prepares a professional campaign brief based on the client’s goals, industry, and target audience.
Suggested SMS Content:
Clients receive expertly crafted bilingual SMS message options (Arabic & English), tailored to campaign objectives and audience behavior.
Message Type Recommendations:
Guidance on the best message formats to use — such as promotional, transactional, reminder, or engagement-driven — depending on the client’s needs.
Audience Targeting Strategy:
Personalized recommendations for segmenting the client’s database or selecting the most relevant profiles from JorMall’s proprietary 7.5 million-user database.
Language Choice and Localization:
Support in choosing the appropriate language (Arabic, English, or mixed) and tone based on cultural and demographic targeting.
Timing Optimization:
Data-driven recommendations for optimal message timing (day, hour, frequency) to maximize engagement.
Landing Page Design:
Optional creation of customized mobile-friendly landing pages that enhance message interaction, provide further information, or facilitate conversions (e.g., bookings, registrations, product views).

b2e558f2-2f0a-53be-9b75-fc9d71af079b.content:

Clients must ensure that the final message content adheres to all applicable TRC regulations and prevailing instructions. JorMall will guide content compliance and reserves the right to decline any message that violates legal or ethical standards.
Use Cases:

Strategic brand awareness campaigns
Seasonal or time-sensitive offers
Event invitations or announcements
Cross-channel engagement with landing page conversion

10f5336b-742f-5ac4-862b-c49eb9422ab6.content:
Product Name: Interactive SMS
Description:
Interactive SMS is an advanced messaging service that transforms traditional SMS into an engaging two-way communication tool. Through this service, JorMall provides clients with customized web-based applications or mobile-friendly pages that are linked directly within the SMS message. These interactive elements enable recipients to respond, participate, or take specific actions in real time.
Key Features:
Embedded Link to Interactive Pages:
Each SMS includes a unique short link directing the recipient to a dedicated page or application designed specifically for the campaign or service.
Custom Applications and Landing Pages:
JorMall designs and hosts tailored landing pages that support various interaction goals, such as:
Surveys and feedback forms
Booking or registration systems
Polls or voting interfaces
Digital brochures or product showcases
Coupon generation and redemption
Two-Way Engagement:
Unlike standard SMS, this service enables the recipient to take an action (e.g., submit a response, fill out a form, confirm attendance), creating a measurable engagement channel.
Mobile-Optimized and Lightweight:
All interactive content is optimized for quick loading, minimal data usage, and seamless performance on mobile devices.
Real-Time Reporting:
Clients receive detailed analytics on user interaction rates, click-throughs, submissions, and conversions, giving immediate insight into campaign performance.
Client Obligations:
Clients must ensure that interactive campaigns are used in accordance with TRC guidelines and do not contain misleading, unlawful, or non-compliant content. All linked pages must clearly identify the sender and purpose of the interaction.
Use Cases:
Customer satisfaction surveys
Appointment confirmations

e2b8c101-022e-516f-b07e-d94151671de4.content:
Product Name: Service Messages
Description:
Service Messages are non-promotional SMS communications sent to clients, customers, or members who have an existing contractual relationship with the sender, or who have requested or approved such messages. These messages are strictly regulated by the Telecommunications Regulatory Commission (TRC) and are used to deliver essential service-related information.
JorMall provides businesses and institutions with a reliable and compliant platform to manage and deliver such messages at scale.
Key Features:
Online SMS Delivery Platform:
Clients are provided with access to JorMall’s secure, user-friendly online platform to manage and send service-related messages.
API Integration:
For advanced automation, JorMall offers API connections, allowing clients to integrate SMS delivery with their internal systems (e.g., CRMs, ERPs, or custom applications).
Regulatory-Compliant Messaging:
All messages must adhere to TRC’s definition of service messages, including:
Messages sent based on an active service contract
Messages sent in response to a customer request
Messages sent with prior client approval
Beneficiary Database Management:
JorMall assists clients in managing their recipient databases, ensuring that:
New beneficiaries are clearly advised of their inclusion in the service message list
All messages to new entries include an opt-out mechanism
No promotional or marketing content is included unless separately authorized
Opt-Out Management and Record Keeping:
JorMall maintains a complete and secure record of all opt-out requests. Any recipient who chooses to unsubscribe will be immediately excluded from future service message deliveries.

a301f847-c869-5414-b6d4-92035d1b7cee.content:
Product demos or feature walkthroughs
Invitations and RSVP confirmations
Time-limited promotional coupons with tracking
Regulatory Compliance:
JorMall’s Interactive SMS service is provided under its TRC Class C License granted on 13 May 2025. All components, including hosted content, are delivered in full compliance with TRC’s telecommunications and digital engagement regulations.

36ef9d52-e6b1-536a-b045-e0ef8f6d5c00.content:
Product Name: Client-based SMS Messages
Description:
Client-based SMS is a high-volume messaging service designed for businesses and organizations that need to communicate with a large number of recipients efficiently and securely. This service enables clients to send promotional, transactional, or informational text messages to their own databases of mobile users.
Key Features:
Flexible Sending Options:
Clients can choose between two modes:
JorMall-Managed Delivery: JorMall sends the messages on behalf of the client using its secure and high-throughput delivery infrastructure.
Client-Managed Delivery: JorMall provides the client with secure access credentials and a web-based or API-enabled interface to send messages directly from their side using JorMall’s platform.
Guaranteed Routing:
All messages are routed through licensed and compliant channels approved by the Telecommunications Regulatory Commission (TRC).
Delivery Reporting:
Detailed delivery reports are provided to the client, showing the number of messages delivered, failed, or pending.
Campaign Scheduling:
Clients can schedule their campaigns for future dates and times with full control over frequency and targeting.
Content Compliance Support:
Our system includes content verification tools to ensure compliance with TRC regulations and consumer protection standards.
Client Obligations:
Clients using the Client-based SMS service must fully comply with all applicable laws, regulations, and the prevailing instructions issued by the Telecommunications Regulatory Commission (TRC), including but not limited to content restrictions and user consent requirements.
Use Cases:
Marketing campaigns
Customer notifications
Appointment reminders
Surveys and feedback requests
Internal communications

5da03668-0578-516d-8e59-4640d89ac4bc.content:
Product Name: International SMS Messaging
Description:
International SMS Messaging is JorMall’s global messaging service tailored for businesses and institutions that need to reach recipients beyond Jordan. This service allows clients to send compliant and high-performance SMS messages to users in over 200 countries via licensed international operators, supporting both promotional and transactional content across time zones and languages.
Key Features:
Global Reach:
Deliver SMS messages worldwide using JorMall’s international gateway partnerships with licensed operators and aggregators in every major region.
Multilingual Support:
Supports all major languages including Arabic, English, French, and more using both GSM and Unicode encoding, ensuring accurate delivery and display.
Time-Zone-Aware Scheduling:
Enables clients to schedule messages based on local times of each recipient’s country for higher engagement rates.
Delivery Confirmation & Analytics:
Provides detailed country-wise delivery status, error codes, and aggregated performance metrics per campaign.
Sender ID Adaptation:
Dynamic sender ID formatting (alphanumeric or numeric) based on each country's telecom regulations to ensure message acceptance.
Secure and Optimized Routing:
Messages are routed through reliable international channels that prioritize speed, uptime, and data integrity.
Regulatory Alignment per Country:
Ensures content complies with the telecommunications laws and marketing rules of the recipient country (e.g., opt-in requirements, language restrictions, Do Not Disturb lists).

11cc6c6d-23c3-5c42-891c-166e965505e7.content:
Product Name: OTP & Financial SMS Messaging
Description:
OTP & Financial SMS Messaging is a high-security messaging service designed for banks, fintech companies, insurance providers, and other institutions requiring instant, reliable, and secure delivery of sensitive information. This service supports the transmission of One-Time Passwords (OTPs), account alerts, transaction confirmations, and other financial notifications in real time.
Key Features:
Real-Time Message Delivery:
Ensures near-instant delivery of OTPs and transactional messages, with latency optimized for authentication and security use cases.
High-Priority Routing:
Messages are routed through high-priority, licensed SMS channels to maximize delivery speed and reliability.
Enhanced Security Protocols:
All communication routes are secured with advanced encryption and access controls to prevent interception, spoofing, or data leakage.
Regulatory-Compliant Messaging:
Messages are fully compliant with TRC regulations for financial and sensitive communications, ensuring lawful and authorized message use.
API Integration:
JorMall provides secure APIs that can be integrated directly into banking, payment, or insurance systems to automate the sending of OTPs and transaction alerts.
Scalability:
Supports high-volume concurrent message dispatch, suitable for large-scale platforms and user bases with high-frequency verification needs.
Fallback & Retry Mechanism:
Built-in redundancy and retry logic ensure that messages are resent if initial delivery fails, maximizing successful reach.
Delivery Reports & Monitoring:
Real-time reporting tools provide insight into message status, delivery performance, and response rates, enabling full audit trails for compliance.

Key Features:
Advanced Targeting Capabilities:
Clients can select target audiences based on multiple filters, including:
Geographic location (city, district, neighborhood)
Age and gender
Income level
Consumer behavior (e.g., car ownership, supermarket shoppers, parents of school-aged children)
Sector-specific interests (e.g., insurance, fashion, electronics, food retail)
Message Delivery via JorMall:
All SMS campaigns are executed directly by JorMall through its secure and licensed delivery infrastructure to ensure compliance and performance.
Performance Monitoring:
Clients receive detailed performance reports indicating campaign reach, delivery success, and distribution by segment.
No Access to Personal Data:
Clients do not receive or access any personal or contact information. Campaigns are executed anonymously through JorMall to ensure full data privacy compliance.
Client Obligations:
Clients must ensure that their content complies with all applicable regulations and the prevailing instructions issued by the Telecommunications Regulatory Commission (TRC). JorMall reserves the right to reject any message that violates these conditions.
Use Cases:
Product and service promotions
Retail events and seasonal offers
Awareness campaigns
New store openings
Loyalty and reward program announcements

7b4d9889-c0fa-5fd0-a4d7-9ef3f286182c.content:
جيل جديد من التواصل عبر الرسائل النصية القصيرة
«جيل جديد من التواصل عبر الرسائل النصية القصيرة» هي حملة تعريفية من جورمول بخدمة الرسائل النصية التفاعلية وروبوتات المحادثة. وتوضّح الحملة كيف يمكن تحويل الرسالة النصية التقليدية إلى تجربة تفاعلية للعملاء، من خلال إضافة رابط لروبوت محادثة مخصّص داخل الرسالة.



يمكن للعملاء فتح الرابط لطرح الأسئلة، والاطلاع على المعلومات المعتمدة عن الشركة، والتعرّف إلى منتجاتها وخدماتها، وتقديم الاستفسارات، والحصول على إرشادات حول الخطوات التالية.



ببساطة، بدلاً من إرسال رسالة نصية أحادية الاتجاه، يمكن للشركات استخدام الرسائل النصية لتوجيه العملاء إلى تجربة تفاعلية مع روبوت محادثة مصمّم خصيصاً بما يتناسب مع احتياجات أعمالها.
